title: The Second Opinion — EN/JA/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Japanese Spanish language learning observational comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, measured delivery]
A man went to see his doctor on a Thursday
The doctor said he was absolutely fine
The man was not entirely convinced
And sought a second opinion

[Verse 1 - English]
He found another doctor on the other side of town
Sat in the waiting room for forty minutes
The second doctor listened very carefully
And said what I'm about to say may surprise you

In my professional opinion
Your first doctor was right
You don't need a second opinion
He was right the first time

[Verse 2 - 日本語 Nihongo]
二人目の医者は注意深く聞きました
(The second doctor listened carefully)
そして言いました、これは驚かれるかもしれませんが
(And said, this may surprise you)
私の専門的な意見では
(In my professional opinion)
最初の医者は正しかったです
(Your first doctor was right)
二回目の意見は必要ありませんでした
(A second opinion was not needed)
彼は最初から正しかったのです
(He was right from the beginning)

[Chorus - Español]
En mi opinión profesional
(In my professional opinion)
Y llevo treinta años haciendo esto
(And I've been doing this for thirty years)
En mi opinión profesional
(In my professional opinion)
Su primer médico tenía razón
(Your first doctor was right)
No necesita una segunda opinión
(You don't need a second opinion)
Necesitaba que se lo dijeran dos veces
(You needed your first doctor to say it twice)

[Bridge - spoken, all three]
He had the pasta on Tuesday — El martes comió la pasta — 火曜日にパスタを食べました
It was reasonable — Era razonable — まあまあでした
He did not seek a third opinion on the pasta
No buscó una tercera opinión sobre la pasta
パスタについて三回目の意見は求めませんでした

[Outro]
He is, to this day, absolutely fine
Está, hasta el día de hoy, absolutamente bien
彼は今日まで、完全に元気です
